## In this session

- Explore the content of the Swiss Elites knowledge base with SPARQL
- Connect the data with the information present in other triplestores: LOD !
- Install a graph editor and edit the existing data

### Documentation

- The relevant documentation is available in the Intro: [Data modelling: standards, interoperability and the semantic web](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/sessions/05.html)

- The code, URLs and instructions are provided in [this repository](https://github.com/Sciences-historiques-numeriques/information-systems/blob/main/rdf-triplestores/elites-suisses/index.md).
